Package org.apache.poi.xssf.binary

Class XSSFBRichTextString

java.lang.Object
org.apache.poi.xssf.binary.XSSFBRichTextString
All Implemented Interfaces:
RichTextString
@Internal public class XSSFBRichTextString extends Object implements RichTextString
Wrapper class around String so that we can use it in Comment. Nothing has been implemented yet except for getString().
Since:
3.16-beta3
